easyPrerequisites: You control at least two Halflings.
description:
Activate The Notary Hobbits by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting The Notary Hobbits.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and The Notary Hobbits.
Repeat.
